reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because it gives a short walkthrough of GMX on Avalanche, displaying an asset and earned-AVAX screen while the speaker describes purchasing a token to participate in commission income. The annual-return figure is the uploader's yield claim, and the Telegram screen contains a non-investment-advice disclaimer; these materials show a DeFi product explanation rather than a deceptive token-sale flow.

opening.argument: The presentation links a financial benefit directly to acquiring a token. The speaker says commission is paid in AVAX and that receiving it requires purchasing the “gmp token,” while also describing that token as a crypto index. That is more than a neutral explanation of an exchange: it presents purchase as the condition for commission income. The title reinforces a return-oriented pitch by pairing GMX and AVAX with “+35% per annum.” A viewer is therefore being encouraged to acquire a crypto product in order to obtain recurring benefits, even though the material supplies no independently verifiable basis for the return or commission claim.

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling this a walkthrough does not remove the solicitation. The cited description of an exchange interface does not establish that the income claim is reliable, and the screen only shows displayed balances, not that commissions can actually be withdrawn or that purchasing the token causes the promised result. The disclaimer in the Telegram material likewise does not cure the explicit purchase-for-commission linkage.

opening.argument: Several risk signals appear together: a quantified annual return in the title, crypto assets and AVAX-denominated income in the narration, and a Telegram channel displaying staking and other income-related instruments. The title foregrounds “+35% per annum,” while the visual material presents a large multi-asset “Staked” balance and an “Earned” AVAX amount. Those displays make passive earnings look concrete, but they do not establish the source, terms, duration, or independent verification of the returns. The combination of a prominent yield figure, staking-related participation, and an external messaging channel is therefore consistent with a solicitation for investment-like participation rather than merely technical education.
